Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha! At last! An inator above all other inators! The one that will finally...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh... (zoom out to reveal the building's power is out again.) Oh, wait. Hold on.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What the heck, Dad?!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Looks like I can't finish making your smoothie, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (flipping the switch as nothing happens) Norm, I told you not to use the blender while I'm powering up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (carrying a flashlight) Now I've got to walk all the way down and flip the whatever that thing is called.

Name: Norm
Dialog: The breaker, sir.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No. You're the breaker. I'm the fixer.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Sorry, Norm. He gets hangry without his smoothie.

Name: Norm
Dialog: At this point, all my pain sensors have numbed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nothin'. Looks like the whole building's out. (gasps) Look at me and my shorting power! It's so evil, I love it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, we have a gym down here? Ooh.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, the electricity's out. Are you... Are you powering that treadmill all by yourself?

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Hi. Yeah. I'm just running through my heartache.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look, I don't need your life story. Spoiler alert

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz Wait, start running again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) When you run, the bulb lights up with human power. (gasps) Aha! I can use human power to power my End-All-Be-All-inator! I just have to channel the energy to my power bank upstairs. (Doof opens the window and calls upstairs.) Norm, drop an extension cord out the window, would ya?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs and dials his phone) Okay, I sorry I was not clear enough, apparently. Find another extension cord, but this time, you hold onto one end of it.

Name: Norm
Dialog: (offscreen) You've got it! Here it comes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (dials phone) No, those are my clothes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This... This is why I have so many extension cords. (dials phone) Okay, now tell me, is one end of the cord plugged into the power bank?

Name: Norm
Dialog: Yes, do I jump now?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no! No jumping! No jumping! Uh, y'know what? Just give the phone to Vanessa. Could you get—? Thank you. Vanessa, I have some very specific instructions for— (An extension cord finally drops out of the sky the way Doof wants.) Oh, thank you, sweetie! (hangs up) I mean, if I don't harness it, this human power is just wasted. (He plugs the treadmill into the extension cord. To the man on the treadmill.) Keep running, dude. Keep running. Keep running.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: (stops running) That's all I've been able to do since my breakup.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. Tell your story running. C'mon. Keep it up! Knees higher! Knees higher! Oh, yeah! You've got good form! Look at you fitter in no time, and nothing makes an ex want you back more than a revenge bod! Right? Amirite?

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Hey, you're a pretty good trainer! Thanks, man.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah! That's the first time anyone's actually listened to me! (dials phone) Norm, did you hear that?

Name: Norm
Dialog: (on phone) I wasn't listening, sir. But the power bank is charging and the lights are back on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, if I can get everyone in town to exercise, I can tap into all this free electricity, store up the surplus and use it to take over the Tri-State Area! I'm gonna need a lot more treadmills.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: And I get a revenge bod.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Less talking, more running.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ahoy, Isabella! Feast your eyes on the Asphalt Wave!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ferb has discovered a way to temporarily alter road surface modules from a solid to a liquid state around the hull. Fascinating!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Geophysics got nothin' on Ferb!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, layman's terms?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We can basically boat the boulevards. We got the idea because Candace and Jeremy are on a boat ride at the lake today.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Aww, that's so romantic!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I guess. But she specifically told us to not go anywhere near them. So we're gonna boat on the roads.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So we're just plagiarizin' them?!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: It's not plagiarism, it's an homage.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Po-tay-to, po-tay-to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's give 'er a whirl!

Name: The gang
Dialog: Bon voyage!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. Doof has purchased a ton of exercise equipment. Stair climbers, dumbbells, smartbells, you name it. And he's been spotted around town wearing... (shudders) ...athleisure wear! I mean, is it athletic or is it leisure? Pick a lane! (A TV monitor descends from the ceiling as Carl enters.) What's even more disturbing is this infomercial Doof has been broadcasting. Hit play, Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Hitting play.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hate working out, but also hate paying for it? Well, come on down to Doofnasium, where I will personally motivate you to pump out iron for free!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (flatly) Check out these gains. Thank you, Doofnasium.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And, guess what? You get all of this for four easy payments of FREE!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Zero! Zip! ¡Nada dinero!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And there's no cancellation fee because you never have to cancel! (solemnly) But don't do it for me. Do it for them.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Right now, there's an elliptical who needs you. Don't you have some time to spare for these poor lonely treadmills?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (stroking a treadmill) I didn't save him. He saved me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Again, it's free! I can't wait to use you, I mean, see you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz, Vanessa, Norm and Man 1
Dialog: At the Doofnasium!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (reading disclaimer rapidly) Doofnasiumisnotliableforanyinjuryinherentriskemotionaldamageordeathyoushouldconsultyourdoctorbeforestartinganewfitnessprogramdoofnasiumbearsnoresponsibilityforanything!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And it keeps going like that for another twenty minutes. Get to the bottom of it, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Should I turn it off, sir?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No. It's disturbingly compelling.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) What can be better than this? A beautiful day.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: A delicious picnic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And a romantic boat ride.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I can think of something better.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (the boat passes by in the background) Hey, Candace! Hey, Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb?! (Getting mad) Oh, that is too bustable!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? Whoa!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys ARE SO BUSTED!!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (over loudspeaker) You can do it! You're almost there!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Keep breathing! She never loved you! Your gains are my gains! And squat!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, it's you! At first, I was like, "Who is that scrawny wimp?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But it was you! Start pedaling! It's leg day, people! Leg day! Whoop whoop!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great. It's not working. Pyeow! Pyeow!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: We're losin' 'em!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We are not losing 'em! (takes out a fishing pole) This chase is about to get "reel"!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like we picked up some gravel skiers! Lookin' good, guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah! Jeremy, get my phone out of my pocket and call my mom!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Your mom? Not, oh, I don't know, the highway patrol?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Uh, Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy, is that you?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yes, ma'am.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (yelling over phone) Tell Mom she has to bust the boys!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is that Candace I hear in the background?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yes, ma'am. She wants to, uh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I know what she wants.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Mrs. Flynn-Fletcher, Candace wants you to—

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, Jeremy, how is your mother? I haven't seen her in ages.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (on phone) Um, my mother's fine, thank you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Her hydrangeas look so good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on phone) Do you know what kind of fertilizer she uses?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No, ma'am, but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Hydrangeas?! Jeremy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes! It's almost full! Come on, people! Ha ha! I have the power! Time to fire the End-All-Be-All-inator! I almost have too much power!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, that's enough. Wait, no! It's too much electricity! It's gonna blow! Okay, gym's closed! That's it! You're all buff enough! Stop... Stop pedaling! It's too much! It's too much!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Idea! I'll plug in more appliances to use up the electricity! Like this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This! This!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aagh! Can we not do this on the treadmill? We're just generating more power. Will you stop?! Listen to me!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: Hey, I think he's starting another class!

Name: Man 3
Dialog: Cool, I'm in!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Me, too!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, career plans? Uh, probably a couple years of community college and...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, come on! (gasps; sees the salon up ahead) The salon! Tell my mom she has to look out the front window in ten seconds!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, look out the window of the salon in ten seconds, ma'am!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (annoyed) Oh, alrighty... (glances at the screen deadpanned)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Ten! Nine! Eight...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Not all my electricity! Curse your gains, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Two...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (over phone) One! Now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, who turned out the lights?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in slow distorted audio) Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoaaa!!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh-oh! Looks like it's overloading. Everyone, abandon ship!

Name: Bobbi Fabulous
Dialog: You look fabulous!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (whining, drops to her knees) But, but, but, but, but...

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: You move us down here because you discovered an underground lake, but we have no way to get around on it! Did ya think a boat would just ooze out of the Earth's crust?
